title: Cubist Portrait
description: A bold cubist interpretation of the feminine form, layered with newspaper fragments and warm earth pigments.
story: This piece was born from my fascination with how we see faces — not as flat images, but as shifting planes of light. Each fragment carries a different perspective, like memories stacked upon each other. The newspaper text whispers stories from another era, grounding the abstract forms in reality.

title: Golden Minarets
description: An architectural mosaic celebrating Islamic geometry, golden domes rising through tessellated desert light.
story: Walking through the old city, the minarets catch the last golden hour light differently each evening. I wanted to capture not a single view, but the accumulated impression of thousands of glances upward — each tessera a snapshot of sky and stone and prayer.

title: Spring Fragments
description: A delicate bouquet deconstructed and reassembled — roses and jasmine in tessellated pastels against iron filigree.
story: My grandmother's balcony always overflowed with flowers in spring. The roses she tended had this quality of being both fragile and fierce. I collaged newspaper fragments as her words, the iron railing as her strength, and the flowers as the softness she showed only to those she loved.

title: Cosmic Metropolis
description: A nocturnal cityscape dissolving into constellations — silver towers, crescent moons, and the electric hum of a city dreaming.
story: Cities at night have always felt like they exist in a different dimension. The silver frame mirrors the cold beauty of skyscrapers, while the deep navy reveals a cosmos hidden just above the rooftops. The crescent moon is both celestial and deeply personal — a symbol of home.

title: Still Life Window
description: A tall acrylic still life painting showing a window with a view of a vase with flowers, a bowl of fruit, and soft light casting shadows on a wooden table.
story: في اللوحة دي، حاولت ألملم تفاصيل اللحظة اللي بتتجمع فيها أشياء بسيطة حوالينا: ورد في فازة، شوية فواكه، وضوء ناعم بيغمر الطاولة الخشبية. الألوان والخطوط بتتداخل عشان تحكي حكاية هدوء ودفء بيتخلل المكان.

title: Flowing Form
description: An abstract mixed media work featuring flowing, organic shapes with swirling shades of blue, brown, and cream blending together on an irregularly shaped canvas.

title: Blue Geode
description: An abstract mixed media piece resembling a geode with swirling blue and grey hues, accented by textured gold edges and a central gold-lined void.

title: Flowing Form
description: An abstract mixed media piece featuring swirling gradients of blue, brown, and white, shaped in an irregular, organic form.

title: Colored Fragments
description: A stained glass-like composition of irregularly shaped fragments in shades of blue, purple, brown, and teal, separated by bold gold lines, set against a black background.

title: Untitled
description: An abstract mixed media composition featuring vivid blue and purple shapes outlined in gold veins against a striped background.
story: This work explores the beauty found in fractured forms, where each section is defined by delicate gold lines. It reflects a fascination with natural patterns and the way light catches uneven surfaces.

title: Sunset
description: A textured epoxy painting with marble stones, crystals, and acrylics. The lower part is rough with earth and clay textures, rising with marble and crystals, while the upper part is clear epoxy representing the sky and clouds at sunset.
story: I called this piece Sunset because I wanted to capture the earth's layers as if I was sculpting the texture with a palette knife. The bottom shows earth and clay textures, with marble and crystals emerging upwards, while the top is a clear epoxy sky. The clouds form as the sun sets, casting shades of sunset colors across the scene.

title: Untitled
description: A vibrant mixed media painting featuring tall candlesticks on a table set against a window view of a landscape with palm trees and a dramatic sky.
story: ممكن تبدل ال still life window بالصوره دي عشان ظبط الاضائه بتعتها
